decisions: WebsiteMocker is the canonical source — not the production repo main branch
Contributor push to production repo main/content/ triggers content-ci.yml → repository_dispatch → automated sync INTO WebsiteMocker (commits content files there)
No auto-publish — operator manually runs /wm-publish when ready
Sync is additive-only: never deletes content already in WebsiteMocker
/wm-add-news stays unchanged — still commits directly to WebsiteMocker
ROADMAP criterion #3 revised: content-ci.yml dispatches sync workflow, NOT publish.yml
CONTRIBUTING.md must set clear expectations: content is reviewed before going live
/wm-init-collab <slug> skill (skill-first pattern, consistent with project conventions)
Idempotent: checks what is already done (branch exists, labels exist, templates present) and skips or updates
Skill guides through human-action steps (creating WM_DISPATCH_PAT, storing in production repo secrets) inline
